Our Process

01
Week 1

Discovery & Strategy

We audit your current site, analyze your competitors, and map every conversion opportunity your business is missing.

Design & Prototyping

We design every page in Figma with conversion psychology baked in. You see exactly what your site will look like before a single line of code is written.

  • Copy & messaging framework

Your involvement: 2 review rounds + feedback sessions
03
Weeks 4-5

Development & Build

We build your site with Astro/React for maximum speed, SEO, and flexibility. Every line of code is clean, semantic, and optimized for performance.

Deliverables

  • Cross-browser testing
Your involvement: Progress updates + preview access
04
Week 6+

Launch & Optimize

We do not just launch and leave. We monitor performance, fix any issues, and set you up for ongoing growth with data-driven optimizations.

Deliverables

  • Production deployment
  • Performance audit & optimization

  • Post-launch support (30 days)
  • Growth roadmap & next steps
Your involvement: Launch approval + handoff call

FAQ

Questions? Answered.

How long does a website project take?

Most projects launch within 3-4 weeks from kickoff. Complex sites with custom functionality may take 6-8 weeks. We give you a precise timeline during our strategy call.

What platforms do you build on?

We primarily build with Astro and React for maximum performance and SEO. For clients who need a CMS, we use headless WordPress or Contentful — giving you easy content management without sacrificing speed.

Will my site rank on Google?

Every site we build follows SEO best practices: semantic HTML, structured data, fast load times, mobile optimization, and clean URL architecture. Many clients see ranking improvements within 30-60 days of launch.

What if I do not like the design?

You get 2 full revision rounds. Most clients love the first direction because we do deep discovery upfront. But if something is not right, we refine until it is.

Do you offer ongoing support?

Yes. Every project includes 30 days of post-launch support. After that, we offer monthly maintenance and optimization retainers for clients who want continuous improvement.
